sentences.text: Researchers developed a special mathematical algorithm that combined features from two networks to improve classification accuracy, achieving a success rate of 94.71% on test images.

In the final test set, one specific model identified 99 out of 105 actual cases and 80 out of 84 non-cases, though the study found this top-performing model was not statistically better than other tested models.
The authors warn that the system requires testing on much larger groups of patients from different hospitals before doctors can use it.
